description.en: Forking naked shoots rise from a bulbous basal body.
description.zh: 分叉裸轴从膨大的球茎状基体上长出。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Horneophyton lignieri; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Horneophyton lignieri 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Bulbous base and branched terminal sporangia distinguish this from Cooksonia's simple capped forks.
distinctness.zh: 膨大基体及分枝顶生孢子囊区别于Cooksonia的简单顶囊。

modeling_brief.en: Keep the swollen base readable above a minimal ground contact; make the sporangial forks one continuous mesh.
modeling_brief.zh: 让膨大基体清楚可见，以连续网格处理孢子囊分叉。

uncertainty: Rhizoids and internal columella are too fine for ordinary environment scale.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Organs and tissues of Rhynie chert plants
sources.supports: Aglaophyton, Horneophyton and Asteroxylon organ architecture and distinctions.
